title: EtherCAT Terminals and I/O
summary: EtherCAT Terminals (EL, ES, EP) and couplers that carry the I/O of Beckhoff systems.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Terminals are processed on the fly as the EtherCAT frame passes through them. Each terminal has an EtherCAT state machine (INIT, PREOP, SAFEOP, OP); a terminal that does not reach OP delivers no valid data.

sections.heading: In PLC Lab
sections.body: EtherCAT is not simulated (see the EtherCAT protocol article). The `beckhoff.twincat3` profile presents the generic rack's channels as linked terminal channels. **CONCEPTUAL** only.
